newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover climbed to 548,790 denars from 527,512 denars with 324 shares changing hands, up from 283 units at the previous session on Thursday.
Gradski Targovski Centar AD sold 285 shares at 1,864 denars each on the first floor, unchanged from Thursday's close and below par of 2,663 denars.
Makedonia Tabak AD made its debut on the third floor, selling 39 shares at 450 denars, well below par of 417 German marks.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week.
